name: whatsapp-web.js
description: A WhatsApp client library for NodeJS that connects through the WhatsApp Web browser app

issues.title: Detached Frame Error  After ~1 Hour Runtime
Puppeteer error r: r on getChatById after latest WhatsApp Web update
Errors r: r on client.getChats() and t: t on client.sendMessage(media)
Message.downloadMedia() throws opaque r: r for all incoming media
Group Messages - "Waiting for this message. This may take a while."
downloadMedia() fails for uncached images with InvalidMediaFileType when mimetype is not forwarded
Client.getState() and Client.getChats() throws r: r despite client being CONNECTED and WhatsApp Web fully loaded

latest_release.name: v1.34.8
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* fix: block unblock contact by @BenyFilho in https://github.com/wwebjs/whatsapp-web.js/pull/201753
* refactor: auth store handling by @RC047 in https://github.com/wwebjs/whatsapp-web.js/pull/201667
* feat: support big file downloads (read from WA cache + streaming) by @Adi1231234 in https://github.com/wwebjs/whatsapp-web.js/pull/201697
* fix: prevent duplicate ready events on SPA re-injection by @Adi1231234 in https://github.com/wwebjs/whatsapp-web.js/pull/201653
* fix: use WWebJS.getChat for inviteV4 fallback in addParticipants by @ashmitmittal in https://github.com/wwebjs/whatsapp-web.js/pull/201792
* fix(client): add fallback for WhatsApp id._serialized renamed to id.$1 by @lindionez in https://github.com/wwebjs/whatsapp-web.js/pull/201832
* fix(media): drop __x_id before spreading mediaOptions into outgoing Msg by @jack-rockstar in https://github.com/wwebjs/whatsapp-web.js/pull/201923

## New Contributors
* @ashmitmittal made their first contribution in https://github.com/wwebjs/whatsapp-web.js/pull/201792
* @jack-rockstar made their first contribution in https://github.com/wwebjs/whatsapp-web.js/pull/201923

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/wwebjs/whatsapp-web.js/compare/v1.34.7...v1.34.8
